Patrick Walsh - CEO | Dogpatch Labs Our Story Dogpatch Labs is a startup hub, located in the historic chq Building and in the heart of Dublin’s Digital Docklands. Our mission is to accelerate the development of Ireland’s startup ecosystem by providing a valuable community from where you can grow, share knowledge and form connections. From Furniture Store... We’re home to over 250 startups and over 500 Members. Alumni include many of Ireland’s fastest growing tech companies such as Instagram, Intercom, Boxever, Voysis, Twilio, Logentries and Profitero. Through the global Google for Startups Network we’re connected to startup ecosystems around the world. ...To Startup Hub With the relocation to the chq Building and under the mentorship of Mervyn Greene and Neville Isdell, we entered a new phase with a distinct identity. Having expanded now to almost 40,000 sq. ft in size

Having expanded now to almost 40,000 sq. ft in size over 3 levels, we’re now better placed than ever to serve the tech community with the help of key partnerships with Ulster Bank, Google and more. ...To National Accelerator In 2021 Dogpatch entered another exciting phase, as we were chosen by the Government to run the NDRC, Ireland’s national accelerator programme.

Now not only do we offer an environment and platform for entrepreneurs to solve global problems, we’re also delivering a mentorship-driven accelerator and early stage supports across Ireland alongside our regional partners Portershed, RDI Hub, and Republic of Work.
A young and dynamic team was assembled and tasked with drawing up plans and designs for a unique coworking space.

The Urban Garden Partnerships with Pivotal Labs, Ulster Bank and Google enabled the development of the Mezzanine Floor, allowing Dogpatch Labs to become Ireland’s largest startup hub at 40,000 sq. ft.
Half of the space serves as hotdesking space for entrepreneurs, while the other half is dedicated to office space for Cainthus and NDRC.

"The expansion into the Mezzanine represents the third and newest development of Dogpatch Labs.' In just 18 months these developments allow us to become the centre of gravity for Ireland's tech ecosystem." The Digital Docklands We are at the heart of Ireland's tech and financial ecosystem.

To the North lies the IFSC - International Financial Services Centre - where a number of Fintech companies are innovating for the 21st century.
